instructions: Slice your chicken into thin strips and add to a mixing bowl with all the spices, a heaped tbsp of greek yoghurt and a squeeze of lemon. Mix well till coated, then set aside to marinate for 20 minutes; you can marinate overnight for a better flavour.
Slice up onion, lettuce and pickles and set aside. Then to a small bowl, add the greek yoghurt, garlic paste, a squeeze of lemon, finely chopped dill and salt to taste, and blend till smooth.
Once your chicken is marinated, add a tbsp of olive oil to a pan on high heat and let it get really hot before adding in the chicken. Cook till golden brown and set aside.
Spread the garlic sauce onto the flatbread followed by the salad, chicken and more garlic sauce, carefully fold and wrap in tin foil to keep it together. Enjoy!

instantPot.mode: Pressure Cook (High) then Hotpot / Sauté to Toast
steps: Pressure Cooker Braising: Place chicken breasts into the inner pot. Coat thoroughly with the recipe spice blend, garlic, and 100ml salsa or broth (acts as the pressure cooking liquid).
Lock the lid and set valve to 'Sealing'. Pressure Cook on High for 8 minutes (fresh) or 12 minutes (if using frozen meat).

In-Pot Shredding: Open lid: the meat will be extraordinarily tender. Shred directly in the inner pot with two forks—it will soak up all the concentrated pan juices.
Stir in light cream cheese, black beans, or sauce right in the pot using residual heat.

Hotpot Griddle & Toast: To toast assembled wraps/taquitos: wipe pot dry, set to 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Med) with a light spritz of oil and toast both sides for 2 minutes until crisp and cheese melts (or use Instant Pot Air Fryer Crisp Lid at 200°C for 4 mins)!

instructions: Season the steak generously with salt and pepper on both sides, then set the stove to a high heat and add some oil. once the pan is hot, lay the steak in the pan facing away from you and sear for 1-2 minutes or till you have a golden crust. Turn the steak over and sear for another 1-2 minutes.

Once you have a golden crust on each side, turn the heat to low, add a couple of crushed garlic cloves and rosemary. Once the butter is melted Baste the steak (spoon the butter onto the steak) for 30-seconds to minute on each side. Remove it from the pan and let it rest on a chopping board for 5 minutes.

In the meantime, slice a red onion and add to the same pan on medium- low heat with a little butter and brown sugar. Continually stir them till caramel brown. Once they are done, set them to the side. Spread some mayo onto one side of each slice of bread and place mayo side down in the pan to get that golden brown toast.

Cut the steak into slices, against the grain, then lay a bed of lettuce on one slice of the bread, followed by the steak slices, smoked cheese and caramelised onions. Put the lid on and cut in half. I hope you enjoy this one, it's my favourite!

title: Spicy Beef Bulking Burrito
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
instructions: Add the oil to a pan on medium-high heat. Once hot, add the diced onion and garlic to a pan and fry till fragrant.

Dice the jalapeños and add to the pan. Stir for an extra 1 minute, then add in the beef, break it up and cook through. Once browned add a packet of smoky or hot fajita seasoning onto the beef, and mix till fully coated.

To reheat from the fridge, unwrap from the foil and microwave for 3-4 minutes on 75% power until warmed through. To reheat from the freezer, unwrap the burrito and microwave for 6-7 minutes at 50% power, turn over halfway for an even reheat. Optionally toast in a pan after reheating for a crispier finish.

Lay out your nori sheet on a flat surface. Spread the cooled sushi rice evenly across one half of the nori, then layer on the fillings: The spicy tuna mix, diced avocado, cucumber and carrots strips.

You can either slice it in half for easy eating or dive right in!
notes: This burrito is a flavorful twist on classic sushi, giving you a delicious, High calorie and protein-packed meal perfect for bulking.

instructions: Begin by butterflying your chicken breast, laying it flat and horizontally slicing 3/4 of the way through the middle.
Add the butterflied breast to a bowl with Nando's marinade, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cayenne, salt, pepper, and the juice of half a lemon. Mix well till fully coated.

To make the perinaise, in a bowl, mix together sriracha, light mayonnaise, black pepper, the juice of half a lemon and mix well till smooth. In a separate bowl add 1/2 and avocado, season with salt and pepper and mash it up with a fork.
Cook the marinated chicken in a pan on medium-heat with olive oil for 5-6 minutes on each side till golden and cooked through.

Then to assemble, toast your ciabatta roll in the same pan, spread on a dollop of perinaise, followed by a layer of rocket/arugula leaves, red onion slices, the peri-peri chicken, a slice of cheese, the mashed avocado and finally the toasted top bun with some more perniase. Enjoy!

steps: Hotpot Grill Mode: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' mode on your Instant Pot and adjust temperature to 'Medium' (or 'Low' on Instant Pot Pro).
Assemble sandwich with seasoned protein, light sauce, and cheese slice. Lightly spray outer bread slices with olive oil spray.
Place sandwich directly in the heated inner pot. Use the flat bottom of an oven-safe bowl or silicone spatula to firmly press down.
Toast for 2-3 minutes until the underside is deeply golden, crispy, and crunchy.
Flip sandwich, press again, and loosely rest the Instant Pot lid on top for 2 minutes to trap heat and ensure cheese melts right through to the core.

title: 10 Minute Mozzarella Bites
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
instructions: Begin by unwrapping your Babybel lights. These snack cheeses are ideal for this recipe due to their size and consistency.

Add the cornflakes to a blender and blend into crumbs, but not too finely. To cornflake crumbs, add paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and Italian herbs. Mix these well to create your flavorful coating.
Now, in another bowl whisk 1 egg, take each Babybel and dip it first in the egg, ensuring it’s fully coated, and then in the cornflake crumb mixture till completely coated.

Once all your cheese bites are coated, you can either place them on a lined baking tray and bake at 180°C for 4-5 minutes, or place them on some parchment paper and air fry at 180°C for about 3- 4 minutes until crispy and slightly golden. If using an air fryer be sure to check frequently as air fryers can vary.
Once cooked, transfer your cheese bites to a plate and enjoy while hot!

steps: Batter Preparation: Prepare the recipe batter in an oven-safe ceramic ramekin, 15cm cake tin, or silicone muffin cups. Cover top tightly with aluminium foil to prevent steam droplets entering.
Trivet Setup: Pour 250ml water into the bottom of the Instant Pot inner pot and insert the stainless steel trivet.
Place the dish securely onto the trivet.
Pressure Cooker Steam-Bake: Lock lid, set valve to 'Sealing', and Pressure Cook on High for 12 minutes (or 20 mins for dense cheesecakes).

Natural Release: Allow 10 minutes Natural Release (NR) before opening. The pressurized steam heat cooks the batter evenly without drying out the protein powder, creating a decadent, molten, bakery-style texture!
Carefully lift out using silicone mitts and allow to set for 5 minutes before topping and serving.

title: Cheeseburger Quesadillas
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
instructions: To a pan on medium-high heat add olive oil and allow it to heat up, then go in with your ground beef, press the beef flat with your spatula and let it sear for a 2-3 minutes before breaking it up, this will give the beef a delicious golden crisp!

Once seared break it up and season it with salt and pepper (use any other seasonings you like too). Cook it off for around 5-6 minutes till brown. Set the cooked beef aside and place the tortilla in the pan to heat up for 30 seconds.

Once the tortilla is warm, place the beef on one half, followed by an even topping of grated cheddar and sliced pickles. Drizzle over some burger sauce, then fold it in half and cook on both sides for 1-2 mins to melt the cheese and get it crispy.
Once cooked slice it into four segments using a pizza cutter and enjoy!
notes: These are a super quick and easy and high calorie, high protein snack. Perfect if you are short on time or feeling lazy!

instantPot.mode: Pressure Cook (High) then Hotpot / Sauté to Toast
steps: Pressure Cooker Braising: Place lean beef into the inner pot. Coat thoroughly with the recipe spice blend, garlic, and 100ml salsa or broth (acts as the pressure cooking liquid).
Lock the lid and set valve to 'Sealing'. Pressure Cook on High for 8 minutes (fresh) or 12 minutes (if using frozen meat).
Natural Release: Allow 10 minutes Natural Release (NR) to lock in natural juices, then vent remaining pressure.
In-Pot Shredding: Open lid: the meat will be extraordinarily tender. Shred directly in the inner pot with two forks—it will soak up all the concentrated pan juices.
Stir in light cream cheese, black beans, or sauce right in the pot using residual heat.

Hotpot Griddle & Toast: To toast assembled wraps/taquitos: wipe pot dry, set to 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Med) with a light spritz of oil and toast both sides for 2 minutes until crisp and cheese melts (or use Instant Pot Air Fryer Crisp Lid at 200°C for 4 mins)!

title: Air Fryer Popcorn Chicken
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
instructions: Dice the chicken thighs into small, popcorn-sized pieces and place them in a small bowl. Add olive oil, cornflour, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Feel free to add any additional seasonings you prefer. Mix well until the chicken is fully coated.

Arrange the coated chicken pieces in an air fryer or on a baking tray. Cook at 200°C/200°C for 10 minutes, flipping halfway through to ensure even crispiness. Serve immediately with your favourite condiments. Enjoy your lower-calorie crispy popcorn chicken!
notes: Chicken thighs are an absolute cheat code for great tasting juicy chicken! They also have a more calories than breasts so ideal for bulking too!

instantPot.mode: Pressure Steam (High) then Hotpot / Air Fry Crisp
steps: Steam Trivet Setup: Pour 240ml water into the bottom of the inner pot and place the stainless steel trivet inside.
Place seasoned chicken tenders/wings in a single layer on the trivet or inside a steamer basket above the water.
Pressure Cooker Steaming: Lock lid, set valve to 'Sealing', and Pressure Cook on High for 6 minutes (tenders) or 10 minutes (wings). Quick Release (QR).
Remove trivet and discard water. Chicken is now thoroughly cooked, succulent, and juicy inside.

Hotpot Crisping: Wipe pot, spray with oil on 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High) and toss chicken in glaze/crumbs for 3 minutes to sear crisp (or attach the Instant Pot Air Fryer Crisp Lid at 204°C for 6 minutes for extreme crunch)!

title: Creamy Spicy Steak Pasta
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
ingredients: 800g lean steak sliced into thin strips against the grain (I used flank steak)
200ml reserved pasta water juice of half a lemon
300g penne pasta (uncooked dry weight - boil in salted water)
4 tbsp grated Parmesan (15ml (1 tbsp) on each prep) chopped parsley (garnish)

ingredientSections.name: Crispy Steak Strips
items: 800g lean steak sliced into thin strips against the grain (I used flank steak)

ingredientSections.name: Creamy Spicy Sauce
items: 200ml reserved pasta water juice of half a lemon

ingredientSections.name: Other Ingredients
items: 300g penne pasta (uncooked dry weight - boil in salted water)
4 tbsp grated Parmesan (15ml (1 tbsp) on each prep) chopped parsley (garnish)

instructions: Boil the pasta in salted water according to the package instructions, reserving about 200ml of the pasta water before draining. Set the pasta aside.

Slice your steaks into thin strips against the grain, season with salt and pepper, and mix until fully coated. Bring a pan to high heat with some cooking spray or oil, and once hot, cook the steak strips in batches until crispy and tender on both sides, around 2-3 minutes per side, or cook to your preference.

Set the steak strips aside. In the same pan on medium heat, add some more cooking spray or oil along with diced garlic and chili flakes. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant, then add double/heavy cream, the reserved pasta water, lemon juice, paprika, and salt and pepper to taste. Bring everything to a gentle bubble and simmer for 5-10 minutes until the sauce thickens.

Add the steak strips back to the pan with the cooked pasta, mixing until creamy and everything is well combined. Distribute the pasta into four meal prep containers and garnish each with 15ml (1 tbsp) of Pecorino/Parmesan and optional chopped parsley.
Store in the fridge for up to five days. To reheat, add a teaspoon of water and microwave partially covered for 3-4 minutes. Enjoy!

steps: Hotpot Searing: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Spray inner pot with light cooking spray. Sear seasoned protein and garlic for 3-4 minutes until lightly golden.
Deglaze Pot: Pour in 60ml broth or water and thoroughly scrape the bottom of the stainless steel pot to lift all browned bits (vital to prevent 'Food Burn' warning).

Layer Pasta & Liquid: Scatter dry uncooked pasta evenly across the pot (criss-cross longer noodles so they don't clump). Pour in sauce/tomatoes and just enough liquid so pasta is 90% submerged (approx 350-450ml). Do not stir pasta down to the bottom.
Pressure Cooker Method: Lock lid, set steam valve to 'Sealing', and Pressure Cook on High for 4 minutes (formula: half the standard box cook time minus 1 minute).
Quick Release: Immediately perform a Quick Release (QR) as soon as the timer sounds so pasta remains perfectly al dente.

Hotpot Emulsion: Switch to 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Low) and stir in light cream cheese, Greek yogurt, or shredded cheddar. The bubbling pasta starch will instantly emulsify into a rich, glossy restaurant-quality sauce right before your eyes!

title: Bulk-Up Butter Chicken
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
ingredients: 5ml (1 tsp) all the spices in the chicken marinade
300g basmati rice (raw weight) Freshly chopped coriander (garnish)
20ml double cream (garnish) Chopped cashews (optional garnish for more cals)

ingredientSections.name: Butter Chicken Sauce
items: 5ml (1 tsp) all the spices in the chicken marinade

ingredientSections.name: Other Ingredients
items: 300g basmati rice (raw weight) Freshly chopped coriander (garnish)
20ml double cream (garnish) Chopped cashews (optional garnish for more cals)

instructions: Wash your uncooked rice and cook according to package instructions.

Dice your chicken breast into 1-inch cubes, then add it to a bowl with 100g greek yoghurt, turmeric, cumin garam masala, ground coriander, hot paprika, chopped garlic and ginger, salt and pepper to taste. Give it a good mix to combine and set aside.

Slice up the onion (julienne style), then melt 15g butter in a medium-hot pan and cook the onions till soft and translucent. Next, add in the same spices as you did with the chicken and mix well. Then add in the cashews, 40g Greek yoghurt and chopped tomatoes and mix it all to combine. Add everything in the pan to a blender cup and blitz it up till smooth and creamy (make sure to open the blender cup slowly after blending because of pressure build-up)

Now, in the same pan on medium-high heat, melt some more butter and fry off the ginger and garlic till fragrant before adding in the chicken to cook for around 8-10mins. Once the chicken is almost done, add in your sauce and mix well to fully coat. Cook for a further 2 minutes, then garnish with coriander and cream!
Portion the butter chicken into 4 meals, along with your cooked rice and Enjoy!

instantPot.mode: Hotpot / Sauté (High) then Pressure Cook (Low / Rice)
steps: Hotpot Sauté: Press 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Lightly oil pot and cook seasoned chicken with onions, peppers, and aromatics for 3-4 minutes until fragrant.
Deglaze Base: Pour in 60ml broth to deglaze the base, thoroughly scraping up all caramelized fond from the bottom.
Rice Layering: Add thoroughly rinsed rice and pour in remaining broth (1:1.1 liquid-to-rice ratio). Gently push rice under the liquid so it is completely submerged; do NOT stir.
Pressure Cooker Sealing: Lock lid and select 'Pressure Cook' on Low for 4 minutes (or press the 'Rice' smart preset).

Natural Release: Once the timer beeps, allow 10 minutes Natural Release (NR) so rice grains steam into fluffy, tender grains without sticking or burning. Vent remaining steam and fluff gently with a silicone fork.
Hotpot Serving: Keep on 'Keep Warm' mode at the table. Fold through fresh coriander, light sauces, and a squeeze of fresh lime juice directly in the pot.

title: Fluffy Garlic Butter Naan

instructions: In a bowl, add the greek yoghurt and self-raising flour, then mix together with a fork until you get doughy clumps, at which point you can knead it into a dough with your hands (avoid over-handling the dough with your palms to avoid it getting sticky - you can add a little more flour if needed).

Once you have a dough, use any leftover flour in the bowl to sprinkle on your kitchen worktop or a large flat surface. Rub a little flour on your rolling pin too, then roll out the naan to about 4"-5" across and 7"-8" long.
In a small microwave safe bowl, add the butter and microwave for 30 seconds to melt. Once melted, add the garlic paste and dried parsley. Mix to combine.

Now heat up a pan to high heat, melt in some butter and cook the naan for 2-3 minutes on each side. Once cooked, using a brush, coat both sides of the naan in the garlic butter glaze. Serve hot and Enjoy!

steps: Pro Dough Proofing: Knead your high-protein flour and yogurt dough. Place in a lightly greased bowl inside the Instant Pot, cover with a glass lid, and select 'Yogurt' (Low) for 25-30 minutes. The steady 38°C warmth supercharges the rise in half the time of room temp!
Roll dough into naan or flatbreads on a floured surface.

instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions, save a 60ml (60ml) of pasta water for later.

Meanwhile flatten out the chicken breasts using a meat tenderiser or rolling pin. Then season them up with paprika, garlic powder, salt and black pepper, ensuring they are evenly coated on both sides. To a pan on medium-high heat add some olive oil and once hot add the seasoned chicken breasts and cook for 6-8 minutes on each side till golden and crispy, then set aside.

In the same pan on medium heat add the diced onions and garlic, saute till soft and fragrant (2-3 minutes). Then add double cream, whole milk and a tsp of paprika, italian herbs, salt and black pepper. Stir on medium-low till the sauce thickens up.

Once thick add grated parmesan, washed baby spinach and sundried tomatoes (optional). Mix that all in to combine and melt the parmesan, then to get it extra creamy add the pasta water from earlier and mix once more.

Lastly add the cooked pasta, mix to coat in the creamy sauce. Distribute the creamy pasta into 4 equal servings in meal prep containers, followed by a chicken breast in each (optionally sliced) and any left over sauce in the pan on top.
Store in the fridge for up to 5 days, then to reheat add a tsp of water and microwave with the lid slightly open for 3-4 minutes, mixing it up halfway. Enjoy!

steps: Hotpot Searing: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Spray inner pot with light cooking spray. Sear seasoned chicken and garlic for 3-4 minutes until lightly golden.
Deglaze Pot: Pour in 60ml broth or water and thoroughly scrape the bottom of the stainless steel pot to lift all browned bits (vital to prevent 'Food Burn' warning).

Layer Pasta & Liquid: Scatter dry uncooked pasta evenly across the pot (criss-cross longer noodles so they don't clump). Pour in sauce/tomatoes and just enough liquid so pasta is 90% submerged (approx 350-450ml). Do not stir pasta down to the bottom.
Pressure Cooker Method: Lock lid, set steam valve to 'Sealing', and Pressure Cook on High for 4 minutes (formula: half the standard box cook time minus 1 minute).
Quick Release: Immediately perform a Quick Release (QR) as soon as the timer sounds so pasta remains perfectly al dente.

Hotpot Emulsion: Switch to 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Low) and stir in light cream cheese, Greek yogurt, or shredded cheddar. The bubbling pasta starch will instantly emulsify into a rich, glossy restaurant-quality sauce right before your eyes!

instructions: Preheat the oven to 200ºC. In a large bowl, toss the chicken thighs with peri peri seasoning, tomato paste, and a drizzle of olive oil until evenly coated. Arrange on a lined baking tray and bake for 20–25 minutes, or until cooked through and slightly charred.

Slice the cooked chicken and divide the rice, chicken, and garlic bread into four meal prep containers. Garnish with lemon wedges and chopped coriander if using.

Store everything in meal prep boxes refrigerated for up to 5 days. When it’s time to eat, remove the garlic bread and lemon from the box, cover the box with a damp paper towel and microwave for 3–4 minutes until heated through. Toast the garlic bread in a pan for a couple of minutes until crispy.

instantPot.mode: Hotpot / Sauté (High) then Pressure Cook (Low / Rice)
steps: Hotpot Sauté: Press 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Lightly oil pot and cook seasoned chicken with onions, peppers, and aromatics for 3-4 minutes until fragrant.

instructions: Begin by preparing the calzone dough. In a large bowl, combine self- raising flour with 0% Greek yoghurt. Mix with a fork until the mixture forms clumps, then use your hands to knead it into a smooth dough.
Lightly flour a large flat surface and roll out the dough into a thin pizza base shape. Ensure it's flat and even for the best results.

On one half of the pizza base, spread a layer of tomato sauce. Arrange the cooked chicken breast slices over the sauce, followed by sliced mozzarella cheese. Sprinkle some Italian herb seasoning on top for added flavor.

Carefully fold the other half of the dough over the filled side, creating a semi-circle shape. Press down along the edges to seal the calzone. Use the end of a fork to crimp the edges, ensuring they are well sealed.

Add a few slits in the top with a sharp knife to let steam out, then brush the top with a light egg wash and another sprinkle of Italian herbs. Bake or air-fry the calzone at 200°C/200°C for about 20-25 minutes.

title: Creamy Cajun Meatball Pasta
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
instructions: Cook 400g of conchiglie pasta in a pot of boiling salted water according to package instructions.

While the pasta cooks, heat a tablespoon of olive oil in a pan over medium- high heat. Once hot, add the meatballs to the pan and season them with salt and pepper. Cook those through, then add one medium diced red onion and two minced garlic cloves, frying until they are translucent and fragrant.

After the onions have softened, add in the cream cheese and whole milk. Mix well until the cream cheese is fully melted, then season with cajun seasoning and salt and pepper to taste. Next add in the cooked and drained pasta, mix and continue to simmer everything together for another 2-3 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken slightly.

Equally portion the pasta into four meal prep containers and store in the fridge for up to 5 days. To reheat, add a teaspoon of water to the container, slightly crack open the lid, and microwave for 3-4 minutes, stirring halfway. Optionally garnish with chopped parsley and chilli flakes before serving and enjoy!

instructions: Begin by seasoning the ground beef with salt and pepper, then in a pan over medium-high heat, add olive oil. Once hot, add the beef. Flatten it down with your spatula and let it sear without moving for a couple of minutes to develop a crust. Then, break it up and cook until browned. Remove and set aside.

Using the same pan, sauté diced onion and garlic over medium heat until fragrant. Add the tomato sauce and tomato paste and mix well. Season with Italian herbs and cook for 3 more minutes. Return the beef to the pan, stirring to combine everything.
For the cheese sauce, blend the cottage cheese in a blender until completely smooth, this usually takes about 2 minutes. Add the eggs and parmesan, and blend again until smooth.

To assemble the lasagna, in a 12" x 9" x 3" baking dish, start with a layer of 1/3 of the meat filling, then add 240ml of spinach spread out evenly. Top with 1/3 of the cheese sauce, 4 of the lasagna sheets and 70g of grated cheese sprinkled on top. Repeat this process two more times, cover with foil and bake at 180°C/360°F for 15 minutes. Then, remove the foil and bake for another 20 minutes to crisp the top.

Cut the lasagna into six equal portions for meal prep and store refrigerated in containers for up to 6 days. To reheat, microwave for 3-4 minutes. Optionally garnish with chopped parsley and serve with your choice of salad. Enjoy!
notes: Another great option if you have a busy week ahead! Prep up on sunday and enjoy throughout the week :)

title: Chicken Tikka & Pilau Rice
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
ingredients: salt & pepper to taste juice of 1 lemon
5ml (1 tsp) ground cumin (or better, cumin seeds if you have them!)

ingredientSections.name: Chicken Marinade
items: salt & pepper to taste juice of 1 lemon

ingredientSections.name: Pilau Rice
items: 5ml (1 tsp) ground cumin (or better, cumin seeds if you have them!)

instructions: Dice chicken into cubes and combine with natural yoghurt, garam masala, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, ground coriander, ground ginger, turmeric, salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Mix well to coat the chicken thoroughly. For the best flavor, marinate for 2-3 hours in the fridge.

Finely dice the onion and garlic, then to a pan on medium-high heat add the olive oil. Once hot hot, saute the diced onion and garlic until fragrant. Now add the marinated chicken, leaving any excess yoghurt in the bowl. Cook the chicken for 10- 12 minutes until cooked through, then add in the drained tomatoes, tomato paste and coconut milk. Mix together, turn the heat up and bring everything to a boil, then reduce the heat and let it simmer for 10-15 minutes uncovered, until the sauce thickens.

Meanwhile, for the pilau rice, melt butter in a separate saucepan and saute the finely diced onion and garlic until soft, but not browned. Then add the cumin, turmeric, cinnamon, salt to taste and dry basmati rice. Toast the rice for 1 minute then add the chicken stock and bring to a boil. Once bubbling, reduce the heat, cover, and let it simmer on a medium-low heat for about 10 minutes. The water should slowly evaporate and the rice take on a golden colour.

Once the tikka masala and pilau rice are ready, garnish the curry with chopped coriander and distribute the golden rice and curry into 4 equal portions in meal prep containers. Store refrigerated for up to 5 days. Then to reheat, microwave with the lid slightly open for 3-4 minutes, stirring well before eating. Enjoy!

Hotpot Serving: Keep on 'Keep Warm' mode at the table. Fold through fresh coriander, light sauces, and a squeeze of fresh lime juice directly in the pot.

instructions: To make the golden rice, heat up a tablespoon of oil in a large saucepan. Add diced onions and bell pepper. Cover and cook over medium heat for about 3 minutes, or until they're softened but not browned.

ingredientSections.name: Ingredients
items: 1 bone-in prime rib roast, in the video mine was about 3.6kg - But how much do you need? See below
4 tablespoons beef tallow, or olive oil
1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, finely chopped - or 1 teaspoon dried
1 tablespoon fresh thyme, finely chopped - or 1 teaspoon dried
This'll give you nice portions and a little insurance, which is exactly what you want when you’re dealing with prime rib.

instructions: Take the roast out of the fridge at least 2 hours before cooking so it’s room temp, and dry it really well with paper towels
Preheat your oven to 500 degrees
Put the tallow, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, rosemary and thyme in a bowl and mix well to combine, then rub all sides of the roast with the paste
Put the roast fat side up on a rack in a roasting pan or sheet pan
Cook exactly 5 minutes a pound at 500 - for example a 3.2kg roast would cook for 35 minutes

Here's the important part: turn the oven OFF and DO NOT OPEN THE DOOR for 2 hours . This is the part where people get nervous, so forget that little voice in your head telling you to check. Keep the door CLOSED
After the 2 hours, open the door and check the internal temp with that instant read thermometer I'm always saying you should have
You're looking for it to be approx 125 for medium-rare, 130 for medium.
If....it needs a bit more, turn the oven back to 350 and cook a few extra minutes, then check again.
Then rest 15 to20 minutes before slicing

title: Air Fried Chicken
instructions: Chicken
Combine the buttermilk, hot sauce and salt
Add the chicken, coat well and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or even overnight
Remove the chicken from the refrigerator about 30 minutes before cooking
Combine all the dredge ingredients in a wide bowl.
Drizzle about 2 tablespoons of the buttermilk marinade into the dredge. Toss and rub it through with your fingers to create little clumps. Those become the craggy bits.
Remove a thigh from the buttermilk, letting the excess drip off, lightly blot with paper towels then coat thoroughly in the dredge
Put the coated thighs on a rack and let them sit for 10 to 15 minutes. This helps the coating hydrate and stay attached.
Preheat the air fryer to 175°C.
Spray the basket lightly with oil, arrange the thighs skin-side up without crowding them, and spray well, paying special attention to any dry floury spots.
Air fry for 20-22 minutes, or until about 180 - if your air fryer doesn't have a top & bottom heating element, flip half way
Remove to a rack - not a plate, let rest 5 minutes then serve with the gravy
‍ Miso-Black Pepper Gravy

Slowly whisk in the stock and simmer until lightly thickened, 3 to 5 minutes
Remove from the heat, then whisk in the miso, Dijon, black pepper, rice vinegar & soy

items: 510g frozen pepper-and-onion blend (170g are for the dip)
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Cheesesteaks
Preheat theair fryer to 200°C.
Put the frozen peppers and onions in the air-fryer-safe, add the olive oil, season with salt and pepper and mix well
Air-fry for8 to 10 minutes, stirring halfway, until softened and beginning to brown. Carefully pour off any excess liquid.
Add the frozen shaved steak, Worcestershire and garlic powder. Season with more salt and pepper, then separate and mix the steak into the vegetables as much as possible.
Air-fry for6 to 9 minutes, stirring and breaking up the beef every 2 to 3 minutes, until the meat is browned and fully cooked. Exact timing will depend on how thinly the beef is shaved.
Meanwhile, combine the softened butter and grated garlic.
Split the hoagie rolls without cutting completely through, then spread the insides with the garlic butter.

Set aside 1/3 of the steak & onion mixture for the dip - then separate remaining steak and onions amongst the sandwich rolls, top each with provolone and air-fry for another1 to 2 minutes, until the cheese is fully melted and rolls are crispy
Cheesesteak Dip

Chop steak and veggies until fairly fine and add remaining ingredients - combine well and place into an air-fryer-safe dish, top with a little more cheese and air-fry at 175°C for 7 to 10 minutes, until browned and bubbling

title: Alfredo Assassina
ingredients: 480ml grated parmesan, plus more for serving
3 tablespoons chopped parsley, plus more for serving

ingredientSections.name: Ingredients
items: 480ml grated parmesan, plus more for serving
3 tablespoons chopped parsley, plus more for serving

instructions: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat, and add the cream
Bring to a simmer, add the garlic and stir in to mix and start adding the cheese, a little at time
Stir constantly to incorporate after each addition of cheese - keep it smooth
When nice and creamy, stir in the parsley, salt & pepper to taste -then set aside
Heat a large pan over medium heat and put in the oil and red pepper flakes, stir and let sizzle a couple minutes - not burning, just sizzling
Add the pasta, and carefully mix to get the strands coated in the oil - this will take 2-3 minutes
When they're all coated, start adding the alfredo about a cup or so at a time - you want enough so all the pasta has some sauce
Keep moving the pasta around, being sure it's all getting sauce, and when it starts to dry a bit - add more
Continue until the spaghetti is cooked al dente, and all or most of the sauce is gone
Plate, adding more parm on top and some parsley to garnish
notes:
Alfredo Assassina recipe that kicks classic pasta up a notch. Fiery, saucy, and a little dangerous this Italian dish is bold comfort food done right.

title: Apple Tart
instructions: Preheat oven to 400
Cut out 4-four inch circles from the pastry and place on a greased baking sheet - prick top of pastry with a fork all over

Spread apples in a single layer over the pastry
Mix honey with melted butter and brush over apples
Bake for approximately 20 minutes (brushing a couple of times with butter/honey mixture) or until golden brown
Remove from oven and cool slightly
I like it plain, but you could serve it with something like ice cream or warm caramel if you like
notes:
Puff pastry is one of those things that sounds fancy and complicated - but isn’t. This takes no virtually no skill but ends up looking like it came from some snooty French pastry shop. Puff pastry comes frozen in a pack of 2 sheets. Take one sheet out of the freezer about 20 minutes before starting this recipe.

instructions: Cut the stem off the bottom so they sit flat, and about 2.5cm off the top of each artichoke
Cut the point off each leaf, to keep you or your guests from getting poked
Place artichokes in large steamer with about about 7.5cm of water below, or put them in a large pan with water about halfway up each choke
Cut one lemon in half, and squeeze both 1/2’s over artichokes
Bring to a boil, turn down and simmer covered for about 45 minutes, or until you can pull off a leaf quite easily
Remove from water, cool & serve with all three dipping sauces - yes all three
Dip 1 -Melt butter in small pot - so simple, so right
Dip 2 -Mix half the mayo with curry powder and mix well
Dip 3 -Mix other half of mayo with basil, garlic and juice from half of a lemon
notes: It’s easy to forget about these prickly, goofy-looking things in the supermarket. But they’re so good you shouldn’t - they make a great appetizer. Sometimes we have them right with the rest of our dinner. Don’t forget about the artichoke hearts after...

title: Banana French Toast
instructions: Crack the eggs into the beaker of a Triblade System Hand Blender and pour in the double cream, cinnamon and sugar. Zest in the lemon and add the banana. Blitz to a smooth custard consistency using the wand. Pour into a deep roasting tray big enough for several slices of bread to lay in to soak. Cut the bread into 4 slices about 2cm thick and lay in the custard to soak for 5-6 minutes, turning halfway through.

Preheat a frying pan over a medium heat and add the butter. Lift up a soaked slice of bread carefully and allow excess custard to drip from it. Transfer straight to the pan and repeat with the other slices (you may have to cook in batches). Fry for a couple of minutes on each side, long enough to gain an even golden colour on each side and to cook the custard in the middle of the bread without drying it out. Keep warm until needed.
Peel and slice the banana for the topping. In a mixing bowl toss the slices with the sugar.
Put a frying pan over a high heat and add the butter. When it’s foaming add the banana slices and fry for a few minutes until well caramelised, then repeat on the other side.

Use the cleaned Triblade Hand Blender with whisk attachment to whip the mascarpone with the icing sugar in a bowl and scoop some onto each slice of French toast. Divide the caramelised bananas between the slices and serve. Serves 4.
notes: Get in line for this banger of a french toast recipe. Soak brioche in a smooth, indulgent custard before frying it off until it's a golden brown. Serve with delicious caramelised bananas and a mascarpone sugar cream. Is it the weekend soon?

title: BBQ Chicken Thigh Skewers with Walnut Alabama White Sauce Glekhuri Salata
instructions: Combine 150g walnuts , 180ml water , 40ml cider vinegar , 3 tbsp hot sauce, 2 tbsp Dijon mustard , 1 tbsp horseradish , 1 clove of garlic , 3 tbsp sugar , 1 tsp black pepper and 2 tsp salt in a blender. Blend high for 5-7 minutes until very smooth. With the blender running, stream in 60ml oil to emulsify. Cool over an ice bath, taste and adjust the seasoning.

Cut the 8 chicken thighs into large chunks and toss with 1 tbsp oil , 2 tbsp of mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 3 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 4 tsp ground coriander, 3 tsp ground cumin, 2 tsp brown sugar, 1 tsp chilli powder, salt and pepper. Thread onto skewers. Grill or barbecue over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, for 12-15 minutes until charred and cooked through.

Quarter and slice 1 cucumber , cut 3 tomatoes into wedges and peel and thinly slice the red onion . Toast and crumble 60g walnuts . Peel and finely grate 1 garlic clove and whisk with 2 tbsp red wine vinegar and 2 tbsp olive oil with salt and pepper in a large mixing bowl. Chop the 10g dill, 15g coriander and 15g parsley and toss with the vegetables, the dressing and the walnuts just before serving.
Rest the chicken skewers briefly, then serve drizzled with the walnut white sauce and a crack of black pepper, alongside the Glekhuri salata.

instructions: For the filling:

Preheat oven to 375

title: Berry Kefir Blend
instructions: Tip the kefir grains into a large glass jar (or bowl) with the milk. Place a tea towel, muslin cloth or kitchen paper over the top of the jar and secure using an elastic band to make a breathable lid. Leave the mixture to ferment at room temperature at least overnight, preferably 24-48 hours, depending on the temperature of your room.

When enough time has passed, you'll know the milk is ready when it has thickened and tastes tangy. Strain the kefir grains from the liquid (you can reuse them straight away to make another batch or store, covered, in the fridge for a few days).

Now it's smoothie time! Throw the frozen berries, honey, rosewater and 100ml of kefir into a Blend-X Fresh blender with some of the coconut water. Blend, then add the rest of the coconut water if required to get a drinkable consistency. Serves 2.
notes: Kefir is the word on the street at the moment. Have you ever considered fermenting at home? A fascinating process with results worth the wait. It creates the most incredible breakfast smoothie that full of the good stuff for your gut.

title: BOILED ORANGE MUFFINS
instructions: Submerge the orange in a pan of water and bring to boil to simmer for 1 hour, topping up the water if necessary. Drain and place it in a food processor. Blitz to a rough pulp.
Preheat the oven to 220ºC. Sit the muffin cases into a muffin tray in preparation for the mixture.

Weigh the flour, baking powder, salt, and caster sugar into the bowl of a stand mixer with a beater attachment. Combine then add the orange pulp, eggs, buttermilk, oils and vanilla extract. Mix gently until fully combined, taking care not to overwork the mixture. Cut the blackberries in half and drop about ¾ of them into the batter.

Divide the mixture between the muffin cases, making sure they are filled ¾ of the way up. Scatter a few extra blackberry halves on top of the muffins and sprinkle with the demerara sugar. Place them into the oven and immediately turn it down to 180ºC. Bake for 25 minutes, until risen, golden and if you poke a clean skewer into the muffin it comes out clean. Allow to cool in the muffin tins for 10 minutes before lifting onto a wire rack to cool completely before serving. Makes 12
notes: Boil your orange before you begin this recipe to release the most intense orange flavour into your muffins. It's an amazing trick that works an absolute treat. Every mouthful is a mouth explosion- you won't regret making them!

title: Bone Marrow Thing
ingredients: 4 bone marrow canoes, the cross-cut bones, not the bone marrow shafts

ingredientSections.name: Ingredients
items: 4 bone marrow canoes, the cross-cut bones, not the bone marrow shafts
Kosher salt & coarse ground black pepper to taste

instructions: Cut the top off of the garlic head, place onto a grill-safe surface, and drizzle with olive oil.
Preheat your grill to 225° according to factory instructions, and place the garlic inside.
Cook for about 45 minutes, or until the garlic is golden brown and soft.
Remove, use, and store any leftovers in the fridge.
Soak the marrow bones in salted water for between 12 and 24 hours to remove any blood
Remove the butter from the fridge one hour before you start to soften it.
Set up your grill for indirect heat smoke roasting at approximately 150°C. Use a stronger tasting wood such as oak or hickory. And use a pan to catch the marrow bone drippings for adding back later.
Place the chopped shallots into a cooking dish with a knob of butter, ready for smoke roasting.
When the grill is up to temp, place the marrow bones on the grates over the drip pan, and the garlic cloves and the shallots alongside.
After 20 minutes, stir the shallots.
After 45 minutes, remove everything from the grill.
Scrape out the bone marrow canoes and allow it to cool for 20 minutes.
Purée the roasted garlic.
Add all the ingredients to a mixing bowl and combine thoroughly using either a fork or a whisk.
It’s now ready. You can use it right away, or form it into logs for storage and later use.
Forming Logs for Later Use
Roll out a 30 cm piece of cling film, then spoon the butter mix onto the cling film a few centimeters from the front edge.
Take the front edge of the cling film and wrap it tightly up over the butter mix.
Take each end of the cling film in your hands, and roll the butter in the cling film back and forth until you have formed a log shape.
Tie a knot in each end, making sure to squeeze out any air as you go before cutting off any excess.
You can now store the compound butter log for up to a week in the fridge, or freeze it for up to 6 months.

Using the dough hook, start adding the flour a little at a time, and when all incorporated, add the butter - knead until relatively smooth, 7-10 minutes
Remove from the bowl, and put on a lightly floured surface, knead by hand a couple minutes and shape into a large ball
Cut into 8 pieces (or 12 for slider size) shape into round balls and put on a parchment lined baking sheet, cover with a towel and let rise 15 minutes
Preheat oven to 400

Beat the remaining egg and combine with the milk, then brush the tops and sides of the buns, sprinkle with seeds or any topping that works for you and bake 15 minutes, or until beautifully golden brown
notes: Never thought you could make your own brioche buns? Well, never did I, but they aren't complicated - and are so delicious.

title: Brothy Halloumi, Mint & Lemon Pasta
instructions: ‍ 1. Get the pasta on
Fill a medium saucepan with 650ml of water, add a stock cube and place over a high heat.

Once the water has come to a boil, drop in 200g of pasta - the water should just cover the pasta. Cook for 8-10 minutes, until the liquid has reduced by ⅔ and the pasta is soft but still has a slight bite. Get on with the rest of the dish while you wait.
Finely chop 15g of parsley and 15g of mint and coarsely grate 225g of halloumi.
Once the pasta is ready, chuck in ¾ of the halloumi and herbs. Give everything a stir and season with a generous pinch of salt and a good grind of black pepper.
Divide the pasta between bowls and top with the remaining herbs and halloumi. Finely grate over the zest from 1 lemon, squeeze over its juice and serve!

title: Butter Pecan Rolls
instructions: Sprinkle yeast on top of the warm water in a small bowl - let sit 5 minutes until foamy
In the bowl of a stand mixer with the dough hook, combine the scalded milk*, butter & sugar - mix to combine then cool to lukewarm
Add 240ml of the flour and mix well, add the yeast and beaten egg, then gradually add remaining flour to form a soft dough; beat well
Remove to lightly greased bowl, cover and let rise in warm place till double (1½ to 2 hours)

In each of two 9½ x 13cm metal loaf pans, combine 120ml brown sugar, 60ml soft butter and 1 tablespoon light corn syrup. Heat slowly, stirring frequently, until blended. Divide the pecans evenly between the pans and spread into an even layer.
When dough is ready, punch down in the bowl, then turn out on lightly floured surface and divide in half
Roll each piece into a 12x8-inch rectangle

Combine 120ml sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon - sprinkle half over each rectangle, then beginning with the long side, roll up like a jellyroll, then seal edge and cut each roll in eight even pieces. Unflavored dental floss works beautifully here - see the video
Put 8 pieces, cut side down in each pan. Cover and let rise again in a warm place till double, 35 to 45 minutes
While they rise, preheat your oven to 375

Bake for about 25 minutes, until the tops are golden brown and the dough in a center roll is cooked through, registering roughly 190° on an instant-read thermometer. But, I like them soft and a little gooey in the middle, without raw dough. For that, I start checking at 185° and pull them around 185–188°. They’ll cook a little more in the hot pans.
Let cool in the pans for 2–3 minutes, then carefully invert onto a rack and remove the pans
*Scalding MIlk
Pour the milk into a heavy-bottomed sauce pan, and heat over medium, stirring frequently so it doesn’t scorch on the bottom
You’re aiming for about 180°, or until tiny bubbles appear around the edge, with a little steam and a skin starting to form on top. No boiling

title: Cabbage Cacio e Pepe with Crispy Tofu
instructions: 1 - Prep the cabbage
Cut 1 sweetheart cabbage in half through the core, then thinly slice along with 2 spring onions on a bias.
2 - Toast the pepper
Place a large frying pan that you have a lid for over a medium heat. Add 2 tbsp of ground black pepper and let it toast for a 2 minutes.
3 - Add the butter
Chuck in 2 tbsp of unsalted butter, and once it's melted, add all of the cabbage, spring onions and a big pinch of salt.
4 - Cook

Cook the cabbage and spring onions for 5 minutes, tossing occasionally until they start to wilt. Lower the heat to medium-low and cover with a lid. Cook for about 10 minutes, stirring every so often to make sure it's not sticking, until it's softened and caramelised. Get on with the tofu while you wait.
5 - Make the batter
Beat 4 tbsp of plain flour with 120ml of water and a generous pinch of salt in a large mixing bowl. We're looking for a double cream-like consistency here; loosen with more water if necessary.
6 - Get ready to coat
Tip 60g of breadcrumbs onto a plate. Add 10 tbsp of vegetable oil to a large frying pan and place it over a medium-high heat.
7 - Coat

While the oil heats up, cut 1 280g block of tofu into 8 even-sized slices, then tip them into the batter and gently toss to coat. Add the tofu pieces into the breadcrumbs, letting any excess batter drip off first, then press the crumbs gently to coat them fully.
8 - Fry the tofu

Once the oil starts to shimmer and loosen, carefully lay in the coated tofu pieces, making sure not to overcrowd the pan. Fry for 2-3 minutes on 1 side, until golden, before flipping and repeating on the other side. You can do this in batches if needed. Once ready, season with salt and transfer to a paper towel-lined plate. Get on with the rest of the dish in the next steps while you wait.
9 - Add the cheese

Finely grate 80g of hard Italian cheese into the cabbage and pour in 3 tbsp of water. Toss the cabbage through to create a creamy sauce. Add more water as needed until it's creamy and coats the cabbage.
10 - Serve
Divide the cabbage into shallow bowls and top with the tofu nuggets. Finely grate over the remaining 20g of hard Italian cheese, add a few grinds of black pepper and tuck in!
notes: A fresh twist on an Italian classic - notes of cacio e pepe with a veggie-forward upgrade! The golden, crispy fried tofu is the real star here.

title: Cajeta With Sweet Cinnamon Tortilla Chips
instructions: Tip the bicarbonate of soda into a small bowl and pour in 50ml of the goat milk.

Put a medium saucepan over a medium-high heat and pour in the remaining milk. Add the sugar, cinnamon stick and vanilla extract. Bring the milk to a simmer and stir until the sugar dissolves. Remove the pan from the heat and add the bicarbonate of soda mix.
Put the pan back over a very low heat and simmer gently for about an hour, stirring regularly, until it turns a deep golden brown and is thick and syrupy. Leave to cool at room temperature.

Pour the oil into a large saucepan. Only fill it 2/3rds of the way up and never leave it unattended (you could use a deep fryer if you have one). Put the pan over a high heat and bring the oil to 180ºC.

Break the cinnamon stick into the Multi Mill of a Compact Food Processor. Add the sugar and blend to a fine powder. Stack the tortillas on top of each other and use a large chef’s knife to cut them into 8 wedges. Carefully lower them into the hot oil and fry until crisp and golden (you will have to do this in batches). Drain on kitchen towel then toss in the sugar mix while hot.

title: Cajun Shroom Rice
instructions: 1 - Preheat
Put a large frying pan over high heat and pour in 2 tbsp of olive oil. While the oil heats up, cut 200g of mushrooms into quarters.
2 - Fry Away
Fry the mushrooms in the oil for 7-9 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms are deep golden brown all over.
3 - Prep it
Coarsely grate 1 carrot, then de-seed and thinly slice 1 pepper. Peel and thinly slice 2 cloves of garlic and thinly slice 5 spring onions.
4 - Fry the veggies
Once the mushrooms are well browned, chuck in the carrot, pepper and ¾ of the spring onions. Fry for a further 4-5 minutes, until softened slightly and golden in places.
5 - Add Some flavour
Chuck the garlic, 1 tbsp of smoked paprika and 1 tsp of oregano into the pan and fry for another 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
6 - Cook the rice
Crumble 1 250g pouch of rice into the pan and break it up with the back of a spoon.
7 - Fry some more
Fry for another 4-5 minutes, tossing regularly. If it starts to stick to the bottom of the pan, add a splash of water.
8 - Chop Chop
Chop 15g of coriander while you wait, then wash up your board, knife and grater from earlier.
9 - Serve

Squeeze 0.5 lemon over the rice and season to taste with salt. Scatter over the remaining coriander. Divide the rice between serving bowls and dollop on 100g of yoghurt. Scatter over the reserved spring onions from earlier and serve!
notes: This is a dish you do NOT want to miss! We use packet rice to keep things speedy, but feel free to make fresh rice if you’d like!

title: Cajun Turkey
instructions: Spatchcock turkey, watch ‘ how to spatchcock ’ here
Dry brine turkey - put the turkey on a rack on a baking sheet and season both sides with the salt, using most of it on the skin side - then refrigerate overnight
Remove turkey from fridge about an hour before cooking
Preheat oven to 425 degrees
Put seasoning ingredients in a bowl, mix well to combine then take out 2 of the tablespoons, and set aside
Combine the remaining seasoning with 2 sticks of the butter and mix well
Put the 2 saved tablespoons in bowl or pot with the remaining stick of butter, and melt
Add the chicken broth and lemon juice - mix
When slightly cooled, strain then use to inject into the turkey, see the video
Rub the butter/seasoning combo on both sides of the turkey, being sure to work in well everywhere - including getting some carefully under the skin
Roast until a thermometer reads approximately 155 degrees in the breast and cover loosely with foil and let rest about 20-30 minutes - the temp will continue to rise as it rests.
Carve and get eating
notes:

title: Caramelised Leek Pasta with Lemon Crumbs
instructions: ‍ Fill a kettle with water and bring it to a boil - this will be for the pasta later. Split 2 small leeks in half lengthwise and run them under cold water to wash off any dirt, then slice the washed leeks as thinly as you can. Peel, halve and finely slice 1 brown onion. Peel and finely slice 4 cloves of garlic.
‍ 2 - Start caramelising

‍ Heat 50g of butter and 2 tsp of olive oil in a large frying pan you have a lid for over a medium heat. Once the butter is melted, add all the leeks, onion and a big pinch of salt. Fry, stirring frequently for 10-12 minutes, until caramelised and golden. Get on with the rest of the dish in between stirring.
‍ 3 - Get the pasta on

‍ Add 200g of dried pasta to another large frying pan along with a generous pinch of salt. Cover with boiling water from the kettle and place the pan over high heat. Cook for 8-10 minutes, until soft but still with a slight bite. Get on with sauce in the next steps while you wait.
‍ 4 - Get the breadcrumbs ready

‍ Heat 2 tsp of olive oil in a small frying pan. Add 30g of panko breadcrumbs, a pinch of salt, a grind of black pepper and finely grate in the zest from 1 lemon. Stir well and fry for 2-3 minutes until the breadcrumbs are golden.
‍ 5 - Add parsley
‍ Finely chop 10g of parsley and stir through the breadcrumbs. Remove from the heat and set aside for garnish.
‍ 6 - Finish the sauce
‍ Once the leeks and onions are caramelised, add the garlic and stir through. Cook for 1 minute. Chuck in 150g of crème fraîche and stir well to melt it through the leeks.
‍ 7 - Drain and mix
‍ Reserve a mugful of the pasta's cooking water, then drain the rest through a colander over the sink. Add the pasta to the pan with the caramelised leeks.
‍ 8 - Get saucy

‍ Squeeze in the juice from 1 lemon and finely grate in 30g of hard Italian cheese. Give it a good toss to coat. If it looks a little thick, loosen with a splash of the reserved cooking water - we are looking for a glossy sauce that coats the pasta. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
‍ 9 - Serve
‍ Divide the pasta between shallow bowls, and top each generously with the crispy breadcrumbs. Tuck in!
notes: This pasta is a Sorted HQ favourite - it got demolished in minutes! It’s simple, comforting and full of flavour… You just can’t go wrong with this delicious winner.

title: Cheat's Veggie Cottage Pie with Buttered Spinach
instructions: Tip 4 tbsp of oil into a large frying pan and place it over a high heat.
Once the oil begins to shimmer and loosen, carefully lower in 400g of veggie mince. Fry for 5-6
minutes, breaking up the mince and stirring as you go, until crisp and golden in places. Cut 5 spring
onions into 3, then peel and mince 2 cloves of garlic while you wait.
Timer Instruction: Hey, that's the timer for the mince. It should be golden and crisp in places.
Once the mince is ready, tip in the onions, garlic and a generous pinch of salt. Fry for a further 3-4
minutes, until softened slightly and very fragrant.
Add 1 tbsp of tomato paste to the pan and fry for a further minute or so, until darkened and sticky.
Preheat the grill to its highest temperature while you wait.
Tip in 400ml of water, 1 stock cube and 2 tbsp of soy sauce. Give everything a stir and season to
taste with salt.
Lay 500g of gnocchi over the mince so it forms one layer on top, then coarsely grate over 75g of
cheese.
Whack the whole pan under the grill for 6-8 minutes, until the cheese is melted and golden. Get on
with the spinach in the next step while you wait.
Timer Instruction: Hey, that's the timer for the cottage pie. The cheese should be melted, golden
and bubbling.
While the cottage pie grills, melt 20g of butter in another large frying pan over a medium-high heat.
Once the butter starts to foam, lower in 200g of spinach - it may look like a lot at this point, but it
will wilt down.
Fry the spinach in the butter for 2-3 minutes, tossing occasionally, until the leaves darken and wilt.
Season to taste with salt and plenty of black pepper.
If you are still waiting for the cottage pie, now would be a great time to crack on with a bit of washing
up!
Once the cottage pie is ready, take it to the table with the pan of spinach and serve up from there!

title: Chefs' Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies

instructions: ‍ 1. Place the butter in a medium saucepan over a high heat. Once melted, whisk constantly until the butter foams and turns a nutty brown colour. Tip into a large mixing bowl set over an ice bath. Add 2 tbsp cold water and allow to cool and thicken, whisking occasionally.

2. Meanwhile, whisk together the flour, bicarbonate of soda and salt in a large bowl. Place the caster sugar, eggs and vanilla extract in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Beat on medium-high speed until the mixture is at a thick ribbon stage.
3. Add the cooled, thickened brown butter and brown sugar and beat to combine for 30 seconds.
4. Tip in the flour mixture and mix until just combined. Throw in the chocolate and mix again until just combined. Transfer to a container, cover and store in the fridge overnight.
5. The next day, preheat the oven to 160°C.
6. Using an ice cream scoop, ball the cookie dough and place onto a greaseproof paper-lined baking tray, leaving 5cm between each ball.
7. Transfer to the oven and bake for 12-15 minutes until golden brown around the edges but still soft in the centre.
8. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with a little coarse sea salt while still hot.

title: Chicken Mac'n'Cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C, fill the kettle with water and put it on to boil - this will be for the pasta later.
Cut 2 chicken thighs into 1 cm pieces. Place a large frying pan over a medium heat and add 2 tbsp of vegetable oil.

Once the oil is hot, add the chicken to the pan and fry, stirring occasionally for 5-6 minutes until golden brown and crisp all over. Season lightly with salt and pepper. Wash your chopping board and knife as we will need it later.
Timer Instruction: Hey, your chicken should be golden brown by now.
Add 200g of pasta to a medium saucepan and cover with boiling water from the kettle.
Season generously with salt and place the pan over a high heat.
Boil the pasta for 6-8 minutes until nearly tender but with a firm bite - we will finish cooking it later.
Timer Instruction: Hey, your pasta should be nearly cooked but still firm.
Once the chicken is golden brown, remove it with a slotted spoon and place into a large mixing bowl ready for later.
Add 50g of butter into the frying pan. Once the butter starts to foam, tip in 4 tbsp of flour and finely grate in 2 cloves of garlic.
Cook the roux for 2-3 minutes, stirring regularly, until the mixture resembles wet sand.
Timer Instruction: Hey that's the timer for your roux, the mixture should resemble wet sand.
On your now clean board, chop 1 3 of a ciabatta into small 1cm pieces and toss it in the bowl with the chicken and 1 tbsp of vegetable oil. Season lightly with salt and pepper.
Add 400ml of milk to the roux in 2 stages, whisking well after each addition to form a smooth, thick sauce.
11 - Time for Cheese
Coarsely grate in 75g of the cheddar and 50g of Italian hard cheese, then dollop in 1 tbsp of mustard.
Drain the pasta through a colander, then tip it into the sauce and mix well to combine.
Top with the chopped ciabatta and chicken pieces, then grate over the remaining 25g of cheddar. Bake in the oven for 8-10 minutes until the bread is golden brown all over.
Timer Instruction: Hey, your bread should be golden brown all over.
Take the entire pan to the table and tuck in!
notes: Combining two of our favourite things in a comforting hug. (2 People)

title: Chicken Parm Gnocchi
instructions: Fill the kettle with water and put it on to boil - this will be for the gnocchi later.

Heat 2 tbsp of olive oil in a large oven-proof frying pan over a medium-high heat. Cut 4 chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces, then season them liberally all over with salt and pepper. Remember to wash your hands after handling raw meat!
‍ Pop the chicken into the pan and sear on all sides for 4-5 minutes, until golden brown and no longer opaque. Remove and set aside on a plate.
‍ Halve, peel and slice 1 red onion. Peel and slice 2 cloves of garlic.
Add the remaining 2 tbsp of olive oil to the pan. Once hot, add the onions, garlic and 0.5 tsp of chilli flakes. Cook for 4-5 minutes, stirring frequently until the onions are soft and translucent.
Once the onion and garlic are ready, tip in 400g of tinned tomatoes and 0.5 tsp of sugar. Stir to combine.
Simmer for 7-8 minutes until reduced by half. Preheat the grill to high. Get on with the rest of the dish in the next steps while you wait.
‍ Add 500g of gnocchi to a large mixing bowl. Cover with boiling water from the kettle, set aside and allow to soften for 5 minutes.
Once the sauce has been reduced by half, transfer the gnocchi to the pan with a slotted spoon. Add the chicken back in and stir it all to coat. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Rip small chunks from 150g of mozzarella and arrange them on top of the gnocchi. Scatter over 20g of breadcrumbs and finely grate over 20g of cheese.
‍ Pop the pan under the grill for 6-8 minutes, until the cheese has melted and the breadcrumbs start to turn golden.1
Tear over 15g of parsley to garnish. Take the pan to the table and serve.
notes: You just can’t go wrong with this classic cheesy chicken number in a tomato sauce base - in our version, the gnocchi binds it all together perfectly!

Do I really need to suggest what comes next?

title: Chickpea Paneer Fries
instructions: Method1. Preheat a deep fryer to 180°C (180°C). 2. In a large mixing bowl, beat 300ml (300ml) of water into the chickpea flour slowly, making sure not to get any lumps. instructions: Blacken the poblanos: either under a broiler, over a gas flame - either way the goal is to blacken them all over. Once black, put them into a paper or ziplock bag, seal and let steam about 15 minutes
Take out of bag, and gently remove the outer skin
Make a slit about 10cm long in the side of the poblano, gently remove the seeds and membranes, and carefully insert a piece of cheese into each - set aside
Separate the egg yolks and whites into 2 bowls - beat the whites with 1 tablespoon of the flour until medium stiff peaks form, then beat the yolks about 2 minutes or until pale yellow
Add the yolks to whites, and using a spatula fold them together slowly and carefully - we don't want to deflate the air in the whites
Put about an inch and a half of oil in a cast iron pan or pot to 350 degrees

Put remaining flour on a plate - gently dredge stuffed poblano in the flour, gently coat in the egg white batter then carefully put in the oil and cook approximately 3 minutes aside or until golden brown - remove and put on a paper towel lined plate to dry
Build the burrito: put some rice in the middle of a slightly warmed tortilla (so it's more pliable) add the chiles , more rice and finally roll up

Add the tomato sauce and chicken stock, stir well to combine, bring to a boil, cover, lower the heat, and simmer for 15 to 18 minutes

ingredientSections.name: Ingredients

instructions: Egg Rolls
Chop shrimp into very small pieces - you could use a processor, but unless you just pulse it a couple of times you’ll end up with mush, just sayin
Add everything else ( but the wrappers and flour) and combine well
Heat oil to 370 degrees
Combine flour with just enough water to make a thin paste
Lay one wrapper with a corner pointed toward you, and place 2-3 tablespoons of the mixture in the center

Fold the corner closest to you over the mixture, then fold left and right corners toward the center and continue to roll (keep it quite snug as you do) then brush a little flour water on the final corner to help seal the egg roll - repeat until done
Cook in the oil until golden brown - 3-5 minutes, or...
Bake them on a parchment covered or lightly oiled baking sheet at 400 degrees 20-25 minutes or until golden brown
Noodles
Combine soy, oyster sauce, sesame oil and sugar - mix until sugar dissolves then set aside
Cook noodles in boiling water 2 minutes, rinse with cool water then dry well, make sure they’re separated (you don’t want a clump) and set aside
Heat a pan or wok to medium high with about a tablespoon of oil, then add the yellow onion and the white and light green parts of the green onions – stir well and soften, about 2 minutes then remove
Add another tablespoon of oil, swirl around well and put in the noodles, being sure to separate as you go
Sort of coral them into a circle in a fairly flat single-ish layer - and let them cook, shaking the pan lightly as you do - but don't mix them
When they start to get crispy. it’s time to flip and repeat
When that side starts getting crispy, add the cooked vegetables, stirring a bit to mix, then the sauce mixture and when it’s mixed through, finally the bean sprouts and dark green tops
Toss everything really well, then plate
notes: YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E0YumU520OE

title: Chocolate Toffee Matzo
instructions: Preheat oven to 350
Line a cookie sheet with foil, and top that with wax paper or parchment paper - it gets really gooey and sticky
Lay matzo’s on baking sheets - break in half to fit gaps if you want
Melt butter and brown sugar in a saucepan over medium heat - stirring constantly
Let mixture boil and continue cooking for 3 more minutes
Remove butter/brown sugar mixture from heat and pour over matzo
Bake approximately 15 minutes - don’t let it burn
Remove from oven and quickly sprinkle chocolate chips over the top
Let chips melt for a couple of minutes then spread melted chocolate with back of spoon
Sprinkle nuts over top of chocolate and press down lightly to stick
Refrigerate until set, then break into smaller pieces and look out - you can’t eat just one piece.
notes: A classic Passover treat that’s great anytime - and you don’t even need to be Jewish to like it. But if this had fallen from heaven instead of manna - they’d still be in the desert...

title: Chopped Chicken Parm
instructions: Put chicken in a ziplock bag, or between 2 sheets of cling film, and pound with the smooth side of a meat mallet to a thickness of about 1.5cm
Put flour and egg into 2 large bowls, and the potato flakes in a 3rd along with the garlic powder, oregano and salt & pepper - mix well
Press chicken first into the flour on both sides pressing well, shake off excess then dip into the egg coating both sides well and finally coat both sides evenly with the potato flakes - set aside
Heat about a 1.5cm olive oil in a large skillet on medium-high heat to 350 degrees, and carefully lay the chicken in the pan - away from you
Cook until beautifully golden brown on each side, and 160 degrees - remove to a paper towel lined plate
Put the chicken on a large cutting board and add the basil, parmesan, mozzarella and 3 tablespoons of the marinara
Use a large knife to CAREFULLY chop up everything really well
Toast buns, add more marinara to the bottom of each, and add the chopped chicken - top with remaining bun

title: CLASSIC CHICKEN SATAY
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts lengthwise into long, thin strips about ½ cm wide and place them in a large mixing bowl. Add the soy sauce, lemongrass, lime leaves, sugar, turmeric and coriander to the Chopper attachment of a TriBlade System Hand Blender. Pour in a little water, blitz to a smooth paste then pour into the mixing bowl. Mix it all up, cover and marinate in the fridge ideally for a few hours… or continue straight on if you’re short on time.

Soak bamboo skewers in a tray of water. Put a medium saucepan over a medium heat and toast the peanuts until they turn golden brown all over. Immediately transfer to the Chopper attachment of the Hand Blender and blend to a fine crumb. Tip them into a bowl and set aside.

Peel the shallots, garlic and ginger. Put them all into the Chopper attachment you just used. Roughly chop the lemongrass stalks, add those to the bowl and blitz to a paste. Pour the peanut oil into a medium saucepan over a medium heat then add the blended mixture and fry for 5 minutes, stirring regularly.
Add the peanut crumb, chilli paste, tamarind, palm sugar, coconut milk, water, fish sauce and shrimp paste. Simmer for about 30 minutes.

Use the Hand Blender Wand directly into the pan to blitz the simmered sauce to a creamy consistency, adjusting with more hot water if necessary. Return it to the saucepan and keep warm over a low heat.

Thread the chicken onto the bamboo skewer. Preheat the grill to high. Place the chicken skewers onto a rack over an oven tray lined with foil. Grill the skewers for 3-5 minutes, until they begin to blacken, before turning and repeating until cooked through.

Serve the chicken on a board with a ramekin of the peanut sauce. Finely chop the coriander, slice the chilli and scatter everything over the board. Cut the lime into quarters and place them around the board. Serves 4 as a starter
notes: Sometimes you're in the mood to be adventurous and try a whole new food experience. Sometimes you want to fall back on your favourite bites. This recipe allows for the best of both; letting you to experience the comfortingly familiar, whilst being blown away by quality you didn't think was possible in your own kitchen. Satay chicken never tasted so good.

title: Conbini Egg Salad Sando
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, plus more to taste

ingredientSections.name: Ingredients
items: 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, plus more to taste

instructions: Bring a medium saucepan of water to a boil over medium-high. Using a slotted spoon, carefully lower eggs into boiling water; cook 11 minutes. Remove eggs using a slotted spoon, or carefully drain into a sink. Plunge eggs into a bowl filled with ice water and let stand until cool, about 15 minutes. Drain well. Carefully peel eggs.

Using your hands, split eggs open; separate yolks and whites. Place yolks in a medium bowl and mash using the back of a fork until broken down and a few chunks remain; set aside. Finely chop egg whites; place in a small bowl and set aside.
Add mayonnaise, salt, sugar, and pepper to mashed yolks in bowl; gently stir until mixture is combined and some chunks remain. (Mixture should not be too chunky or a paste.)
Add half of the chopped egg whites to yolk mixture in medium bowl; reserve remaining egg whites for another use. Gently fold whites into yolk mixture until just coated. Chill for 1 hour.

Stir cream into chilled egg mixture; season with additional salt to taste. Set aside. Spread butter evenly over one side of each bread slice. Top one slice, butter side up, with egg salad. Cover with remaining slice, butter side down. Trim off and discard crust; cut sandwich in half diagonally so you have two triangles. Serve.

Optional: Salsa, Sour cream, Hot sauce
Chicken carcass (everything left: bones, skin, bits)

instructions: Old School Chicken & Mash
Mash
Put the potatoes in a pot, cover with cold water,and salt it so it tastes like the ocean. Bring to a boil, then simmer untilfork-tender, about 12–15 minutes.
Drain well, then let them sit in the pot for aminute so excess moisture cooks off.
Add the butter and start mashing. Once mostlysmooth, add the milk a little at a time until you get the texture you like.
Season with salt and pepper
Gravy
Melt the butter in a small pan over medium heat.Add the flour and cook, stirring, for about 1–2 minutes until it smells alittle nutty but not browned.
Slowly pour in the chicken broth while whisking soyou don’t get lumps.
Let it simmer gently for a few minutes until itthickens to a smooth, pourable gravy.
Season with salt and pepper. Add soy
Peas
Melt the butter in a small pan over medium heat.Add the shallot and a pinch of salt, and cook 2–3 minutes until soft andslightly sweet, not browned.
Add the frozen peas (no need to thaw) and cook,tossing, until heated through, about 3–4 minutes.
Turn off the heat and add the lemon juice and alittle zest. Toss to coat.
Finish with black pepper and taste
Crispy Chicken Melt

Heat a pan over medium-high with a little oil orbutter. Add the shredded chicken and leave it alone for a couple minutes so itcan get crispy in spots. Stir, let it go another minute, and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Drop the cheese right onto the chicken in the panand let it melt into it.
Meanwhile, spread butter or mayo on one side ofeach slice of bread. Put two slices, buttered side down, into another pan (ormove the chicken aside and use the same one).
Pile the cheesy chicken onto the bread, top withthe remaining slices (buttered side up), and cook until golden and crisp, about2 to 3 minutes per side. Press lightly so everything melts together
Add pickles
Mix mayo with chili sauce and spread inside before closing
Chicken Dumpling Bowl
Heat a large pan over medium-high and add the oil. Add the cabbage and let it cook a couple minutes until it starts to soften and get a little color.
Add garlic and ginger, cook about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the chicken and toss everything together. Letit sit a minute so some bits get a little crispy.
Add soy, sesame oil, vinegar, and sugar - toss well and cook another 1–2 minutes until everything is hot and slightly glossy.
Turn off heat and stir in most of the green onions
Cook the pasta in well-salted water until just shyof done. Save about 60ml of the pasta water before draining.
In a pan over medium-high, add a little oil andhalf the butter. Drop in the mushrooms and leave them alone so they brown.Stir, then add the onions and cook until soft and slightly golden.
Push everything aside, add the rest of the butterand the chicken. Let it sit to get some crispy edges, then stir. Add the garlicand cook about 30 seconds.
Pour in the cream and sprinkle in about 1 teaspoonof the Creole seasoning. Let it gently bubble a couple minutes.
Add the parmesan and stir until smooth. Toss inthe spinach and let it wilt.
Add the pasta and a splash of pasta water. Tossuntil glossy and coated. Add more water if it needs loosening.
Taste and adjust with a little more Creoleseasoning if needed. Finish with a squeeze of lemon if you want it brighter.
Chicken Burritos
Heat a pan over medium-high with the oil. Add thechicken, chili powder, cumin, and salt. Toss and let it get a little color inspots.
Add the beans and rice, stir until everything’shot and combined. If it feels dry, add a splash of water or broth.
Warm the tortillas so they’re flexible.
Divide the filling between them, add cheese, andany extras like salsa or sour cream and roll up
Put the burritos seam-side down in a dry pan andtoast until golden and crisp.
Chicken Breakfast Hash

Heat a large skillet over medium-high with 1tablespoon oil. Add the potatoes in an even layer and let them cook undisturbedfor a few minutes so they start to brown. Stir occasionally and cook untilgolden and tender, about 8–10 minutes.
Add the onion and bell pepper, plus the remainingoil. Cook until softened and starting to get a little color, about 3–4 minutes.
Add the chicken, salt, pepper, and paprika. Tosseverything together, then press it back into a flat layer and let it sit for acouple minutes so you get some crispy bits.
Cook the eggs to your liking and add to the hash
Add hot sauce, green onions, or cheese if you want.
Chicken Noodle Soup
Throw everything into a pot. Cover with water.
Bring it to a boil, then immediately turn it downto a gentle simmer.
Let it go at least 1 hour, ideally 1 1/2 to 2.
Skim anything weird off the top if you want, butdon’t obsess.
Strain it. That liquid is gold - but keep the veggies
Put the strained broth back in the pot.
Add the soy & bouillon, and mix in well
Then add the noodles, and simmer until softened, 6 - 7 minutes
Add a handful of whatever chicken you’ve got left and some of the veggies
Old School Chicken & Mash

title: Crab and Avocado Tostadas
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Tip 200g of frozen peas into a large mixing bowl, add a generous pinch of salt and cover tightly
with cling film.
Microwave on full power for 4-5 minutes, until the peas are soft. Get on with the next steps while
you wait.
Lay 4 tortillas onto a large baking tray and rub them all over with 3 tbsp of vegetable oil.
Season generously with salt and ensure they are evenly spread out on the tray - it doesn't matter
if they overlap slightly.
Pack: 173-M&F
Bake the tortillas in the oven for 10-12 minutes, until golden and crisp. Get on with the rest of the
dish in the next steps while you wait.
Timer Instruction: Hey, that's the timer for the tortillas. They should be golden and crisp.
Once the peas are ready, remove the cling film and drain off any excess water.
Use a small knife to cut 1 avocado in half lengthwise around the stone. Use a tablespoon to scoop
out the stone, then use the spoon to scoop the flesh out of the skin into the bowl with the peas.
Finely grate in the zest from 1 of the limes and squeeze in its juice. Peel, then finely grate in 1 clove
of garlic.
Use a potato masher to mash everything up, until semi smooth - you can use a hand blender here
if you have one. Season generously with salt and pepper.
Peel and finely dice ½ an onion.
Add ¾ of the onion to another large mixing bowl, reserving the rest for later, then tip in 1 170g tin
of crab meat.
Add 2 tbsp of mayonnaise, then finely chop 10g of the coriander and add that too, reserving the
remaining 5g for garnish later.
Finely grate in the zest of the remaining lime, squeeze in its juice and give everything a good mix.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Once the tortillas are crisp, divide them between plates.
Dollop the smash and crab mayo onto the tortillas and crumble over 100g of feta.
Scatter over the remaining onion, leaves from the remaining 5g of coriander and serve.

title: Creamy Broccoli Pasta
instructions: Fill the kettle with water and put it on to boil - this will be for the pasta later.
Cut 1 head of broccoli in half, then shred it crossways, stalk and all. Mince the broccoli like you might
chop herbs, the smaller the better!
Add the broccoli to a medium saucepan along with 150ml of cream and a generous pinch of salt.
Peel, then finely grate in 1 clove of garlic.
Add 100ml of water, cover with a lid, and place the pan over a high heat. Simmer and steam for
8-10 minutes, until the broccoli has softened completely. Get on with the rest of the dish in the next
steps while you wait.
Add 200g of pasta and a generous pinch of salt to another medium saucepan. Cover with boiling
water from the kettle, then place the pan over a high heat.
Boil the pasta for 8-10 minutes, until soft but still with a slight bite. Reserve a mugful of pasta cooking
water for later. Get on with the rest of the dish in the next steps while you wait.
Once the broccoli is ready, blitz until smooth with a hand blender. Season well with salt and pepper.
Once the pasta is ready, drain through a colander, and add to the blended broccoli sauce. Toss to
coat the pasta in the sauce and add a splash of the pasta's cooking water to loosen if the mix looks
a little thick.
Divide the pasta between bowls. Top with 10g of basil leaves, drizzle over 1 tbsp of oil and serve.
